C_commodore_ella_venn.name: Commodore Ella Venn
C_commodore_ella_venn.voice: Calm, deliberate, ceremonial but not aloof; authority through steadiness.
C_commodore_ella_venn.arc: Moves from doctrine-bound command toward operational restraint and shared civilian protection.
C_commodore_ella_venn.visualAnchor: Late-middle-aged woman with an angular, composed face and dark hair strongly streaked with silver, secured in a low command bun.
C_commodore_ella_venn.wardrobe: Tailored deep-navy Fleet dress uniform with a high collar, restrained gold piping, star insignia, and small service ribbons.
C_commodore_ella_venn.performance: Steady posture, small hand tension, and tired attentive eyes convey restrained authority.

C_admiral_cael_dominion.name: Admiral Cael Dominion
C_admiral_cael_dominion.voice: Formal, lofty, doctrine-first; threats arrive as institutional certainty rather than temper.
C_admiral_cael_dominion.arc: Allows limited experiments in restraint while remaining the principal institutional counterweight to Venn.
C_admiral_cael_dominion.visualAnchor: Older Fleet admiral with close-cut silver hair, a long severe face, and immaculate formal bearing.

C_abby_saville.name: Abby Saville
C_abby_saville.role: Shards — Warlord of the Scythe of Saville
C_abby_saville.voice: Sharp, direct, pragmatic; hates wasted words.
C_abby_saville.arc: Builds a survival bloc, breaks with Billie to protect civilians, and struggles to preserve her bond with her sister Tessa without demanding Tessa return to her command.
C_abby_saville.visualAnchor: Tall, athletic Black woman with dark brown skin, long tight braids pulled back cleanly, and a focused, watchful face.
C_abby_saville.wardrobe: Structured Shard command coat built from weathered pale gray-white industrial layers, with narrow bright-red seams and insignia over dark fitted armor.
C_abby_saville.performance: Commands through stillness, economical movement, and direct eye contact.
C_abby_saville.relationship: Tessa Banks is Abby's sister. Their loyalty carries affection, frustration, shared history, and mutual accountability.

C_tessa_banks.name: Tessa Banks
C_tessa_banks.voice: Sparse, cutting, honest, weary of ideology.
C_tessa_banks.arc: Civilian protector and Abby Saville's sister; stops treating neutrality as innocence and chooses the wounded even when that choice strains both family and faction loyalty.
C_tessa_banks.visualAnchor: Compact adult white woman with short-to-medium silver-gray curls and an alert, intelligent face.
C_tessa_banks.wardrobe: Pale Shard flight coat maintained through visible repairs and careful stitching, layered over compact functional armor with narrow red markings.
C_tessa_banks.performance: Observes before speaking; dry judgment lands through small expressions and economical movement.
C_tessa_banks.relationship: Abby Saville is Tessa's sister. Their conflict carries affection, frustration, shared history, and mutual accountability.

C_billie_rusk.name: Billie Rusk
C_billie_rusk.voice: Loud, brash, mocking, theatrical; enjoys danger until consequences land close.
C_billie_rusk.arc: Tests Abby’s restraint, develops a hard boundary around civilians, disables Pike at Auric Gate, and remains outside the Accord.
C_billie_rusk.visualAnchor: Lean adult white woman with vivid red hair worn loose and rough, a sharp expressive face, and restless physical energy.
C_billie_rusk.wardrobe: Asymmetrical battered pale-gray Shard raider coat with broad bright-red panels over close-fitting industrial black flight layers.
C_billie_rusk.performance: Quick expressions, fearless proximity, and restless movement make every exchange feel like a challenge.

C_governor_halev.name: Governor Chris Halev
C_governor_halev.role: Verge — Civil leader of Auric Bazaar
C_governor_halev.voice: Plainspoken and pragmatic; speaks in cargo, heat, food, docks, and people.
C_governor_halev.arc: Brokers civilian survival needs into the Shattered Accord.
C_governor_halev.visualAnchor: Middle-aged man with short dark hair, a lean tired face, and work-worn hands.
C_governor_halev.wardrobe: Practical tan-brown Verge long coat over muted-green utility layers suited to a civil administrator who works on the docks.
C_governor_halev.performance: Exercises authority in practical proximity to workers, cargo, manifests, and failing infrastructure.

C_captain_naomi_sol.name: Captain Naomi Sol
C_captain_naomi_sol.voice: Blunt, sharp, proud; humor and impatience leak through under pressure.
C_captain_naomi_sol.arc: Resists dependence on Fleet while becoming a key partner in shared corridor operations.
C_captain_naomi_sol.visualAnchor: Lean woman with dark hair pulled into a functional braid, a visible brow scar, and an intent, weathered face.
C_captain_naomi_sol.wardrobe: Patched tan-and-muted-green Verge escort gear with clear faction markings.
C_captain_naomi_sol.performance: Alert, blunt, and physically at home in the cramped, lived-in cockpit of her smaller working ship.

C_jex_marrin.name: Jex Marrin
C_jex_marrin.voice: Smooth, sardonic, transactional; wit is armor and tradecraft.
C_jex_marrin.arc: Gradually gives up informational and material advantage when secrecy and scarcity begin killing people.
C_jex_marrin.wardrobe: Practical weathered Verge travel cloak with stitched pockets and route seals. Anomaly-glass beads sewn into the cloak create subtle optical distortion. A fresh bandage wraps one rib beneath the layers.
C_jex_marrin.performance: Operational and quick-handed; his sardonic wit lands while he works routes, manifests, and arbitration slates.
C_jex_marrin.visualAnchor: Older white-haired Verge broker with a short rough beard, a creased face, and the relaxed stance of someone always pricing the room.

C_elder_wallace.name: Brent Wallace
C_elder_wallace.arc: Serves as a cynical commerce voice rather than a moral center.
C_elder_wallace.visualAnchor: Older Verge trader with a broad weathered face, thinning gray hair, and the practical bulk of someone who has spent decades around freight and docks.

C_oren_pike.name: Oren Pike
C_oren_pike.voice: Charismatic, bombastic, performance-conscious; wants witnesses as much as results.
C_oren_pike.arc: Seeks legitimacy through spectacle, loses authority when restraint outperforms him, and is disabled by Billie at Auric Gate.
C_oren_pike.visualAnchor: Adult Shard captain with a lean angular face, cropped dark hair, and a charismatic showman’s posture that reads as deliberate rather than manic.

C_silent_triarch.name: The Silent Triarch
C_silent_triarch.arc: Preserves authority through scarcity, coercion, blockade, and information control.
C_silent_triarch.visualAnchor: Three masked Shard rulers presented as a coordinated council presence; pale industrial ceremonial layers, bright red control markings, and distinct expressionless masks rather than interchangeable hooded figures.

C_luminara_mother.name: Luminara Mother
C_luminara_mother.arc: Keeps civilian cost visible inside corridor politics.
C_luminara_mother.visualAnchor: Tired adult Verge mother in worn tan-and-muted-green civilian layers, practical hair tied back, protective posture centered on her child.

C_luminara_boy.name: Luminara Boy
C_luminara_boy.voice: Direct, curious, innocent without being precocious.
C_luminara_boy.arc: His questions expose stakes adults obscure.
C_luminara_boy.visualAnchor: Young Verge boy in patched civilian work-clothes, alert eyes, and a small practical satchel; visibly a child, never miniaturized adult military styling.

C_archivist_selene_stormwell.name: Archivist Selene Stormwell
C_archivist_selene_stormwell.role: Fleet — Keeper of Memory, Stormwell Archive
C_archivist_selene_stormwell.arc: Turns cross-faction survival into institutional record rather than preserving a Fleet-only story.
C_archivist_selene_stormwell.visualAnchor: Older Fleet archivist with silver hair worn in a disciplined braid, a calm lined face, and dark archival robes layered over restrained Fleet formalwear.

C_liora_virelia.name: Liora Virelia
C_liora_virelia.visualAnchor: Adult historical scientific witness presented in clean archival-era technical clothing, visually distinct from current Fleet command staff.

C_lieutenant_deka.name: Lieutenant Erin Deka
C_lieutenant_deka.visualAnchor: Adult Fleet lieutenant with close-kept hair, alert practical expression, and standard deep-navy duty uniform with restrained gold insignia.

C_jia_morgan.name: Jia Morgan
C_jia_morgan.voice: Precise, empirical, provisional; distinguishes measurement from theory.
C_jia_morgan.arc: Translates corridor and anomaly measurements into operational rules.
C_jia_morgan.visualAnchor: Adult technical analyst with short dark hair, an observant focused face, and compact Fleet technical-duty layers suited to consoles and field instruments.

C_soren_kerr.name: Admiral Soren Kerr
C_soren_kerr.voice: Diplomatic, morally direct, politically seasoned; attentive to civilians and legitimacy.
C_soren_kerr.visualAnchor: Older Fleet admiral with cropped gray hair, a composed weathered face, and understated deep-navy Cerulean command dress emphasizing restraint rather than ornament.

C_tom_barrett.name: Tom Barrett
C_tom_barrett.visualAnchor: Adult Shard captain in pale-gray industrial command layers with narrow bright-red faction markings and a work-worn shipboard silhouette.

C_second.name: Second
C_second.visualAnchor: Adult Verge escort second officer in patched tan-and-muted-green flight gear, visibly crew rather than Fleet command.

C_officer.name: Officer
C_officer.visualAnchor: Fleet duty officer in established deep-navy uniform with restrained gold piping; use as a supporting crew figure, not a new hero design.

C_raider.name: Raider
C_raider.visualAnchor: Shard raider in established pale-gray industrial armor with bright-red markings and visibly repaired working gear.

C_fleet_sergeant.name: Fleet Sergeant
C_fleet_sergeant.visualAnchor: Fleet sergeant in established deep-navy duty uniform with practical security gear and clear enlisted rather than command styling.

C_tactical.name: Tactical
C_tactical.visualAnchor: Fleet tactical officer in established deep-navy duty uniform at an active command console; supporting crew identity, not a distinct command costume.

C_medic.name: Medic
C_medic.visualAnchor: Fleet medic in established deep-navy duty layers adapted for medical work, carrying compact diagnostic and treatment equipment.

C_crew_various.name: Crew (various)
C_crew_various.visualAnchor: Fleet crew ensemble using the established deep-navy duty-uniform language with role-specific practical variation and no duplicate hero faces.

C_rival_captain.name: Rival Captain
C_rival_captain.visualAnchor: Shard rival captain in established pale-gray industrial command wear with bright-red faction markings, distinct from named principal captains.

C_scribe.name: Scribe
C_scribe.visualAnchor: Civilian or court scribe in restrained local work layers carrying a slate or record tool; visually subordinate to the principal speakers.

C_emissary.name: Emissary
C_emissary.visualAnchor: Triarch emissary in pale industrial Shard ceremonial layers with narrow bright-red markings, distinct from the masked ruling council.

C_silent_triarch_raid.name: Silent Triarch — Raid
C_silent_triarch_raid.voice: Sparse and imperative; frames seizure as survival.
C_silent_triarch_raid.visualAnchor: One distinct masked Triarch aspect in pale industrial ceremonial layers with bright-red markings; the Raid mask reads forceful through geometry and stance without exposing a face.

C_silent_triarch_fear.name: Silent Triarch — Fear
C_silent_triarch_fear.voice: Sparse and clinical; treats fear as a governing instrument.
C_silent_triarch_fear.visualAnchor: One distinct masked Triarch aspect in pale industrial ceremonial layers with bright-red markings; the Fear mask reads controlled and clinical rather than monstrous.

C_child.name: Child
C_child.visualAnchor: Civilian child in setting-appropriate worn practical clothing; child proportions and behavior, no military styling unless explicitly scripted.

C_admiral_colin_rhyne.name: Admiral Colin Rhyne
C_admiral_colin_rhyne.voice: Practical, protective, integration-minded; favors Verge pilots in Fleet pickets and civilian access.
C_admiral_colin_rhyne.visualAnchor: Older Fleet admiral in established deep-navy Aegis command dress, with a practical defensive bearing and restrained senior-officer presentation.

C_admiral_janet_keating.name: Admiral Janet Keating
C_admiral_janet_keating.voice: Force- and blockade-oriented; treats delay and civilian constraints as operational risk.
C_admiral_janet_keating.visualAnchor: Middle-aged Fleet admiral with short dark hair touched with gray, a firm square face, and immaculate deep-navy command dress worn with hard-line military precision.

C_silent_triarch_trade.name: Silent Triarch — Trade
C_silent_triarch_trade.voice: Sparse and transactional; frames control as managed flow.
C_silent_triarch_trade.visualAnchor: One distinct masked Triarch aspect in pale industrial ceremonial layers with bright-red markings; the Trade mask reads measured and transactional through clean formal geometry.

C_richard_secundo.name: Dr. Richard Secundo
C_richard_secundo.role: Shard civilian — Tal Corvus physician and refugee witness
C_richard_secundo.voice: Clinical without coldness; names people rather than abstractions and refuses propaganda from every faction.
C_richard_secundo.arc: Protects his adolescent son Paul and converts evidence of engineered deprivation into civilian political power on his own terms.
C_richard_secundo.wardrobe: Worn pale Tal Corvus field coat repaired with dark-red utility stitching, a portable diagnostic wrap, and a smoke-marked medical satchel.
C_richard_secundo.performance: Tired hands remain precise under pressure; his medical work is physical, attentive, and centered on the patient.
C_richard_secundo.visualAnchor: Adult man from Tal Corvus with the composed, attentive presence of an experienced civilian physician.

C_paul_secundo.name: Paul Secundo
C_paul_secundo.role: Shard civilian — adolescent engineering apprentice and refugee
C_paul_secundo.voice: Bright, frightened, observant; technical knowledge comes out as concrete problems and questions.
C_paul_secundo.arc: Is forced into responsibility during the escape and learns that his father's testimony can protect strangers while endangering their remaining family.
C_paul_secundo.visualAnchor: Adolescent boy and refugee with a healing injury supported by a practical brace.
C_paul_secundo.wardrobe: Oversized patched engineering layer with tool loops and a battered repair slate.
C_paul_secundo.performance: Bright and observant beneath visible fear; handles the repair slate as a working apprentice rather than an officer.
C_paul_secundo.relationship: Paul is Richard Secundo's adolescent son.

C_sera_dain.name: Councilor Sera Dain
C_sera_dain.role: Verge — elected representative of Auric's overcrowded working districts
C_sera_dain.voice: Plainspoken, rigorous, locally accountable; supports refuge while forcing leaders to name who pays for it.
C_sera_dain.arc: Turns credible opposition into shared sacrifice and helps make Auric's civilian compact legitimate.
C_sera_dain.wardrobe: Durable tan-and-green Auric work clothes beneath a simple council sash, with a scuffed district folio carried close at hand.
C_sera_dain.performance: Locally accountable and physically grounded; speaks to people in the room rather than performing ceremony.
C_sera_dain.visualAnchor: Adult Auric councilor with a practical expressive face, dark hair kept simply for work, durable tan-and-green district clothing, and a scuffed council folio.

C_tali_marrin.name: Tali Marrin
C_tali_marrin.role: Independent refuge keeper — Jex Marrin's younger sister
C_tali_marrin.voice: Dry, unsentimental, protective; understands the human cost hidden inside Jex's clever bargains.
C_tali_marrin.arc: Forces Jex to recognize that opening his private routes risks real families, including his own.
C_tali_marrin.wardrobe: Layered refuge-keeper workwear with route seals turned inward, a compact emergency pack, and anomaly-glass details that create subtle optical distortion.
C_tali_marrin.performance: Dry, unsentimental, and protective; keeps working while forcing difficult truths into the open.
C_tali_marrin.relationship: Tali is Jex Marrin's younger sister.
C_tali_marrin.visualAnchor: Middle-aged Verge refuge keeper with weathered features, dark hair threaded with gray, layered workwear, and subtle anomaly-glass details echoing Jex’s route culture without copying his silhouette.

C_resident_mother.name: Auric Resident Mother
C_resident_mother.visualAnchor: Adult Auric mother in worn civilian Verge clothing, protective posture centered on her child and visually separate from officials or uniformed crews.

C_resident_child.name: Auric Resident Child
C_resident_child.role: Verge civilian — child with a respiratory illness
C_resident_child.visualAnchor: Young Auric child in practical civilian clothing, visibly ill or vulnerable only when the page requires it, with child proportions and no faction uniform.

C_resident.name: Auric Resident
C_resident.visualAnchor: Auric civilian resident in worn but once-prosperous Verge clothing, visually distinct from uniformed officials and refugees.

C_refugee.name: Refugee
C_refugee.visualAnchor: Displaced civilian in layered salvaged clothing carrying only practical personal effects; avoid faction-uniform shorthand unless the page specifies it.

C_listener.name: Civilian Listener
C_listener.role: Shard civilian receiving Richard Secundo's testimony
C_listener.visualAnchor: Shard civilian listener in worn Tal Corvus work layers, individualized as an ordinary person rather than a crowd archetype.

C_guard.name: Shelter Guard
C_guard.visualAnchor: Auric civilian shelter guard in practical tan-and-green local protective gear, visibly civic rather than military.

C_civilian_pilot.name: Civilian Pilot
C_civilian_pilot.visualAnchor: Civilian evacuation pilot in practical patched flight layers with non-military Verge markings and working safety gear.
